message: The anonymous type '{0}' cannot be used in both run-time and compile-time code in the same template. Change the property names or types of one of the anonymous objects, or use a named type instead.
title: An anonymous type cannot be used in both run-time and compile-time code in the same template.
rationale: Both texts duplicate 'can't' and use a contraction, and 'used as both run-time and compile-time' lacks a noun. The message gives no way forward although the fix is obvious: anonymous objects with the same property names and types share one type, which TemplateAnnotator.VisitAnonymousObjectCreationExpression (line 725) requires to have a single scope.
